meta.title: Once a vendor has bid, RFQ weights are locked unless the round allows edits
gaps: act 1: PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}}/edit_weight_parameters is sent with no body — a request step carries the body the case writes (or a library/operation step has a working one)
The decisive PATCH request cannot be expressed because the case does not provide its happy-path request body, and no operation or listed body fields define the weight-edit payload.
The round setting trade_config.allow_edit_weight_param_rfq cannot be set or verified with the available vocabulary.
RFQ weights are not available in read-back fields, so 'nothing changed' cannot be verified.
